about.bio_paragraph_1: tare da shekaru 3-5 na kwarewa wajen gina mafita daga farko zuwa ƙarshe. A halin yanzu ina RHI Magnesita, ina aiki akan duk aikace-aikacen—daga na'urorin gaba zuwa tsarin baya da kayan aikin cloud.
about.bio_paragraph_2: Ina da digiri na BSc a Kimiyyar Kwamfuta daga PUC Minas, tare da karatun bayan jami'a a Tsaron Bayanai (UTFPR) da Digital Forensics (IPOG). Aikina ya haɗa da OutSystems, JavaScript, C#, Python, da hanyoyin DevOps na zamani.
about.bio_paragraph_3_end: (mai fassara mai rantsuwa) ne don Portuguese da Turanci, ɓangaren sha'awata masu yawa da ke ci gaba da haɗa ni da harshe da sadarwa.
about.bio_paragraph_4: Lokacin da ba na rubuta lambar, za ku same ni ina karatu (littattafai 280+), bincike, ko binciken kowane batun da ya dawo da sha'awata.

projects.title: Ayyukan Lambar
projects.project_1_desc: Aikin bincike da ke bincika hanyoyin sadarwa na halayen siyasa a Brazil ta amfani da hanyar ResIN. Binciken da aka buga tare da UTFPR/UNIGOU.
projects.project_2_desc: Kasida ta BSc a PUC/MG tana bincika tasirin hanyoyin sadarwa na hanyoyin watsa ƙarya na firehosing.
projects.project_3_desc: Ayyukan Azure DevOps Nanodegree ciki har da Terraform, IaC, bututun CI/CD, da gwaji.
projects.project_4_desc: Aikace-aikacen yanar gizo na Flask tare da cikakken aiwatar da bututun Azure CI/CD.
projects.project_5_desc: Aikin injiniyan bayanai yana aiwatar da bututun ETL tare da PostgreSQL don nazarin watsa kiɗa.
projects.project_6_desc: Aikin tsarin bayanai na NoSQL yana amfani da Apache Cassandra don bayanai na watsa kiɗa.
projects.project_7_desc: Mafita na adana bayanai na cloud yana amfani da Amazon Redshift don ayyukan nazari.
projects.project_8_desc: Sarrafa babban bayanai tare da Apache Spark a AWS don tsarin tafkin bayanai mai girma.
projects.project_9_desc: Bututun bayanai da aka shirya ta amfani da Apache Airflow don ayyukan ETL na ta'aziyya.
projects.repos_count: Ma'ajin 32+ • Mai Ba da Gudummawa na Arctic Code Vault
